text.en: Experiments with gpt-4 is row 73 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: Experiments with gpt-4 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 73 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates Experiments with gpt-4 with “Sparks of artificial general intelligence: Early experiments with gpt-4”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Experiments with gpt-4 与论文《Sparks of artificial general intelligence: Early experiments with gpt-4》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Sebastien Bubeck, Yi Zhang”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Sebastien Bubeck（官方页拼写）、Yi Zhang（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Sebastien Bubeck, Yi Zhang”。
